fusions.name: Arrest on Sight
fusions.desc: Throws a set of bars that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Rattled Bars
fusions.desc: A clatter of the bars that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% per affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Outstanding Writ
fusions.desc: Sets a cage trap at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and deals 22 damage to the first enemy that comes within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: In Custody
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
